decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (numbered: WL-R01-PR-101, WL-R01-PR-108, WL-R01-PR-109, WL-R00-EX-108, WL-R00-EX-109, WL-R00-EX-101, WL-R00-EX-105, WL-R00-EX-102, WL-R00-EX-103, WL-R00-EX-104, WL-R00-EX-107, WL-R01-PR-102, WL-R01-PR-103, WL-R01-PR-104
Amended drawings received: 05/04/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extensions hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 128 Wood Lane, and not as primary residential accommodation or for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen or bathroom facilities be installed into the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.

Condition : 6 - The extensions hereby approved shall be used solely as part of the house known as 128 Wood Lane and shall not be occupied as a separate dwelling nor used for business purposes and the premises shall not be used as a house in multiple occupation, including any use within Class C4 of The Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) or such other legislation as may subsequently supersede it.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension and erection of an outbuilding
